## Security verdict: PASS

PR #179, exact head `09225b0c2126cef406fe44fcbfc2931086c57044`.

The complete `21f1187..09225b0` delta is test-only. Failed window reads remain errors; success requires a nonempty list containing only work windows. Polling retains failures until its deadline with diagnostics (`crates/tmux/tests/control_mode.rs:590-612,722-759`).

| # | Severity | File | Lines | Vulnerability | Confidence |
|---|----------|------|-------|---------------|------------|
| - | - | - | - | No vulnerability identified | - |

Regression assertions reject error, empty, mixed and control-only results and require a killed-server read to return an error. This closes the old vacuous-positive test path in source. No product code, C19/C21 disclosure, fixture secret or harmful argument interpolation was added.

GitHub metadata and the independent remote pull ref agree on the full reviewed SHA; GitHub reports CLEAN. CI run `42450878231` and latest successful Delivers run `42450878201` both identify this SHA and success. The earlier cancelled Delivers run is superseded.

No local tests, builds, tmux operations, probes, credential reads or mutations were performed; source assertions are not independent execution proof.
